subject: National Level Technical Symposium - Technovanza 2026 Rescheduled
description:
Lekha Lokare <lekhalokare.28@gmail.com> 
Mon, Jun 8, 1:42 PM (3 days ago) 
to me 
Dear Participants, 
 
Greetings!!! 
 
Due to unavoidable administrative reasons, the National Level Technical 
Symposium - Technovanza 2026, which was originally scheduled from July 10, 
2026 to July 12, 2026, has been postponed. 
 
The symposium will now be conducted from July 24, 2026 to July 26, 2026. 
 
Event Timings: 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM 
 
Venue: Main Auditorium, SRMIST, Kattankulathur 
 
All registrations remain valid and participants are not required to 
register again. 
 
For any queries, please contact the organizing committee.
